titulo_en: When and while in a story

texto.@es: Usa **while** a menudo para introducir la acción que estaba en curso y **when** para el hecho que sucede durante ella. El orden puede cambiar: **While I was waiting, the bus arrived** / **The bus arrived while I was waiting**.
texto.@en: Use **while** often to introduce the action that was ongoing and **when** for the fact that happens during it. The order may change: **While I was waiting, the bus arrived** / **The bus arrived while I was waiting**.

texto.@es: **While we were walking, it started to rain.** = Mientras caminábamos, empezó a llover.
texto.@en: **While we were walking, it started to rain.** = As we walked, it started to rain.

pregunta.@es: Completa con el pasado continuo: While we ___, it started to rain.
pregunta.@en: Complete with the continuous past: While we _ _ _, it started to rain.

explicacion.@es: Con we usamos were + verbo en -ing.
explicacion.@en: With we used were + verb in -ing.

explicacion.@es: El pasado simple no muestra que la acción estuviera en curso.
explicacion.@en: The simple past does not show that the action was in progress.

bloques.frase: While they ___ for the bus, it started to snow.

explicacion.@es: Con they usamos were + verbo en -ing.
explicacion.@en: With they we used were + verb in -ing.

explicacion.@es: Es pasado simple; la consigna pide la acción en curso.
explicacion.@en: It is simple past; the slogan calls for ongoing action.

bloques.frase: The phone rang while I was driving.

explicacion.@es: «While I was driving» indica una acción en curso.
explicacion.@en: «While I was driving» indicates an ongoing action.

explicacion.@es: Esa opción está en presente y futuro.
explicacion.@en: That option is present and future.

explicacion.@es: No conserva el orden temporal de la frase.
explicacion.@en: It does not keep the order of time of the sentence.

bloques.frase: The children were playing when their mother arrived

traduccion.@es: Los niños estaban jugando cuando llegó su madre
traduccion.@en: The kids were playing when their mother came in.

explicacion.@es: «When» introduce el hecho que ocurre durante el juego.
explicacion.@en: «When» introduces the fact that happens during the game.

pregunta.@es: Escribe en inglés: «Mientras lavaba los platos, se rompió un vaso.»
pregunta.@en: Write in English: «While I was washing the dishes, a glass broke.»

respuestas: While I was washing the dishes, a glass broke.

explicacion.@es: La acción de lavar estaba en curso cuando se rompió el vaso.
explicacion.@en: The washing action was in progress when the glass was broken.

intro.@es: Practica unir dos acciones pasadas con una regla breve y ejemplos claros.
intro.@en: It practices to link two past actions with a brief rule and clear examples.
